rows.label: Mortality ratio for children 6-59 months with untreated MAM compared to non-malnourished and treated malnourished children (Chad)
rows.explainer:
A country-level figure for Chad from David Roodman's analyses of historical cohorts (Table 9, p. 45 of his 2022 report on anthropometry and mortality), not one district's: GiveWell uses it for every Chad site, Ngouri and N'Djamena in its ALIMA sheets and Guera in its IRC sheet.

The same number in 3 of GiveWell's sheets: alima-malnutrition-treatment-chad-2021-with, alima-malnutrition-treatment-chad-2024-renewal, international-rescue-committee-malnutrition-treatment-irc-standard.
